commit_subject: release: 4.8.55 — README refresh for the Fable 5 era (publish to npm) (#481)
maintenance_rule: Treat this external-source baseline as immutable. Future parity work must compare against this exact commit first, then optionally add a new baseline for a newer external-source commit/version with an explicit delta report.
minimum_parity_gate: Every XPROXY-* capability row in the pinned inventory is mapped to implemented, intentionally superseded, or explicitly out-of-scope-with-approval.
All implemented/superseded mappings have failing-first tests before production code.
The external reference pinned commit and version are recorded in generated parity reports and CI output.
